summaryFa: اتوبوس دیر کرده، اما رفتار آرام یک نفر به یک جمع بی‌قرار سرایت می‌کند.
storyFa: زیر سقف ایستگاه اتوبوس، قرمز کلافه است و صورتی با نگرانی ساعتش را نگاه می‌کند. آبی آرام است و برای بقیه جا باز می‌کند. در قاب بعد، باران و انتظار ادامه دارند، اما قرمز آرام شده و همان حرکت مهربان و مطمئن را برای بنفش تازه‌وارد تکرار می‌کند؛ صورتی هم از بی‌قراری دست می‌کشد.
meaningFa: آبی مانع باران یا تأخیر نمی‌شود؛ آرامش را با طرز رفتار منتقل می‌کند و تحمل موقعیت را برای اطرافیان آسان‌تر می‌سازد.
english: Calm is contagious. Be calm to help others.
persian: آرامش مسریه. آروم باش تا به بقیه هم کمک کنی.
revisionSummaryFa: خوانایی انگشت‌های دست، برق بسیار کوچک داخل چشم‌های تیره، مژه ظریف صورتی در هر دو قاب و ته‌رنگ گونه محو اصلاح شدند. ایده، متن، موقعیت آدمک‌ها و داستان حفظ شده‌اند.
revisionFeedbackFa: بعضی از آدمک ها انگشت هاشون واضح نیست و اون نقطه سفید داخل چشمشون و یا لپ های سرخ و برخی هم که باید مژه داشته باشند رو ندارند. بقیه تصویر و ایده خوبه
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: one complete finished square watercolor illustration for an illustrated Persian translation of Kevin Kelly's adult advice book. Depict the meaning of "Calm is contagious. Be calm to help others." This English sentence must not appear inside the artwork.
Illustration specification: create the complete original scene below with the consistent established character family, face treatment, layered watercolor paint and clear visual storytelling.
Visual style: genuine hand-painted, moderately layered transparent watercolor on white textured paper. Show uneven translucent washes, gentle pigment pooling and overlapping color shapes inside the heads AND bodies, not only around the outer border. Natural irregular watercolor margins leave clean white paper all around. Warm, humane, artistically composed, readable at a glance. Neither flat vector nor wax crayon, marker, colored pencil, shiny plastic or 3D render. Contours are thin darkened local body colors, never black outlines. Subtle deeper local-color crescent immediately under each head separates head and torso; no visible neck.
Character design: simple adult neutral figures, genuinely circular heads of equal width and height, soft slender-to-medium adult limbs and balanced proportions like the reference, never chubby arms, bulbous bodies, very thin stick bodies or chibi proportions. Every figure shares the SAME neutral torso silhouette: no breasts, hips, waist indentation, buttock emphasis, hairstyle or selective clothes. PINK is the female character: in BOTH panels add only two or three tiny fine curved lashes at the outer upper edge of each existing usual eye, without changing the eye shape or body. Blue, Red and Violet retain the standard unlashed eyes. Eyes are small dark vertical ovals, EACH OPEN eye with one tiny white reflected-light dot inside the dark oval. There is no white sclera or altered eye structure. Give the characters very subtle translucent warm rosy cheek washes with soft diffused watercolor edges, no flat pink circles. Minimal brows and warm expressive mouths. Every hand has exactly THREE fingers plus ONE thumb, FOUR digits total. Make the visible rounded finger lobes and thumb clearly readable in the existing gestures. Open welcoming palms show three fingers and one distinct thumb; hanging hands show three short finger lobes and one side thumb. Overlapped and folded hands preserve natural occlusion: do not invent extra arms, hands, digits or expose hidden fingers. Preserve the pink wristwatch interaction. Full bodies and significant objects remain safely inside the art. No special clothing is necessary. Stable character color and identity throughout all panels: emotions change through face and posture, never by changing a character's body color.
Reading: if multiple panels are described, read right to left, with discreet white gutters and no heavy boxes. Preserve the same location and props between the story beats. Maintain simple spatial continuity and clearly related cause and effect. The calm BLUE figure models calm, rather than merely smiling indifferently; the others visibly become calmer and repeat its approach. The underlying inconvenience need not vanish. Render only the explicitly listed short Persian dialogue, accurately and legibly in the bubble assigned to its speaker. No English, explanatory paragraph, panel labels, numbers, logos or watermark.

Story and composition:
Composition: square art, TWO horizontal panels of the same simple roofed bus shelter in gentle rain, the same frontal three-quarter view, a small wet curb and empty road. No traffic danger, accident or storm. A small ordinary bus-stop sign can use a bus pictogram only. Background spare and uncluttered. Blue, Red, Pink and Violet neutral adult figures, fully shown inside each relevant panel.
TOP: BLUE waits peacefully beneath the roof with shoulders low and a quietly attentive expression, makes room with one gentle open hand for PINK. RED beside them is impatient, arms tense and brows knitted; PINK looks anxious at a wristwatch. BLUE addresses the others in one short Persian bubble: «آروم، بالاخره می‌رسه.» No bus appears and the road is visibly empty. BLUE does not ignore the others or meditate with closed eyes.
BOTTOM: the same empty road, same falling rain, same shelter: nothing external has fixed the delay. BLUE stays calmly present. PINK's watch arm now hangs relaxed, and PINK no longer checks the time. RED has relaxed its shoulders and now echoes BLUE's gentle open-palm gesture while making room under the roof for VIOLET, who has just arrived damp and worried but is relaxing as RED welcomes it. RED's short bubble reads exactly: «بیا اینجا، جا هست.» The transition should make it visible that BLUE's calm presence has become RED's calm welcoming behavior and is reaching VIOLET. The gentle humor is the shelter occupants making an extra careful little sideways shuffle to fit everyone, not a pratfall. No umbrellas, cars or extra decorative props.
Framing: pull back in each panel enough to show every full character, all feet, all furniture and a strip of floor beneath. Natural table/counter occlusion is allowed but no body part is cut by the panel border. Reduce all subjects to fit the wide scene inside each of the two panels.

editInstructionEnglish:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Image 2 is an approved STYLE REFERENCE only for tiny eye highlights and anatomically clear simple hands. Edit Image 1 very conservatively; it is already accepted for its idea, painting, scene, characters, text and arrangement. Do NOT redesign or replace its story.

CHANGE ONLY these small character details:
1. Each existing OPEN dark oval eye should contain one tiny restrained white reflective dot near its upper area, as in approved reference. Keep the exact existing dark oval eye size, placement, shape, expression and gaze. The tiny white dot must be INSIDE the dark oval; absolutely no white sclera surrounding a pupil, no enlarged eyes, no new eye anatomy.
2. Make the existing PINK character female using only two or three very fine short lashes attached to the OUTER UPPER corner of its existing normal dark oval eyes, in BOTH panels. Keep the eye shape and body unchanged. Do not add conspicuous fan lashes or lashes to other characters.
3. Add very subtle, translucent, softly diffused rosy cheek washes to these characters, consistent with their body colors and the existing watercolor. Barely perceptible warm blush, no flat round pink spots and no sharp edges.
4. Clarify existing visible hands/fingers in their EXACT current positions and gestures. Every hand has precisely THREE fingers plus ONE thumb = FOUR digits total, NOT five. Hands hanging down may have three short rounded finger lobes together and one small side thumb. Open welcoming palms show a distinct thumb and three rounded fingers. The folded/overlapping hands remain folded in place: show the visible fingers clearly but do not invent extra hands, arms, digits, or force hidden fingers into view. Preserve the pink watch interaction in top panel.

PRESERVE UNCHANGED:
The two vertically stacked horizontal panels; exact bus shelter and its benches, roof, posts, sign, empty road and continuing rain; all character numbers, positions, colors, poses, expressions, gazes and head outlines; truly circular heads; balanced neutral adult bodies, neither thinner nor chubbier; neutral female torso without breasts/hips/waist curves; thin darker-local-color outlines; moderate layered real watercolor in bodies and background; white irregular paper margins; existing framing with all feet contained. Do not add clothes, hair, props, umbrellas, bus, extra background elements, decorative objects, or labels.
TOP: red impatient at left, calm blue in middle gesturing toward pink at right; pink checking wristwatch.
BOTTOM: blue calm at left, relaxed pink, relaxed red welcoming worried damp violet at right. Keep violet still a little worried; red/pink have become calm. The weather and delay remain unresolved.
Preserve exact Persian speech bubbles unchanged: TOP blue «آروم، بالاخره می‌رسه.» and BOTTOM red «بیا اینجا، جا هست.» No other text, no English, no watermark.
Return one finished square illustration retaining the entire original image, with only the specified facial/hand refinements.

qa.storyAndCauseEffect: The same bus shelter and continuing rain remain in both panels. Top red stays impatient and pink checks the watch; bottom red welcomes worried violet and pink is calm. The underlying delay is not removed.
qa.persianTextObserved: آروم، بالاخره می‌رسه. / بیا اینجا، جا هست.
qa.styleObserved: Small white highlight dots are inside the dark oval open eyes, without sclera. Pink has fine short outer lashes in both panels; torsos, proportions and watercolor remain unchanged. Cheek washes are faint and diffused.
qa.handsObserved: Open welcoming palms retain three fingers and a thumb. Hanging hands now have clearer rounded finger divisions. Folded and watch-touching hands preserve natural overlap rather than exposing every occluded finger.
qa.framingObserved: The two stacked panels, shelter, sign, empty road, rain, original poses and full feet remain contained as before.
qa.limitations: Folded hands and the wristwatch touch retain natural occlusion; all four digits are not separately visible on every occluded hand.

rootVisualReview.observations: Actual result preserves rain, delayed bus, cast, calm-spreading gestures and Persian bubbles. Open eyes have small internal glints without white sclera. Pink has fine lashes in both panels; soft blush appears most clearly on blue/violet. Open palms and hanging hands have readable contours. Crossed hands and watch-touching fingers have natural overlap.
